title: V11 native foundation and first capability migration

units.title: Active repository control plane
units.build_scope: Create V11 programme state, build plan, evidence and ledger directories, capability matrix, source-resource register, validation workflow and deterministic browser projection.
units.test_scope: Prove all control surfaces agree, the laboratory is read-only and no laboratory capability is represented as implemented in V11.
units.acceptance: A fresh worker can recover the active repository, current unit, objective, laboratory anchor, capability state and validation state without conversation history.

units.title: Clean installation and one start command
units.build_scope: Create a V11-owned installation and startup contract rather than wrapping a mutable laboratory checkout.
units.test_scope: A fresh V11 clone installs and starts through one documented command.
units.acceptance: The V11 browser reaches a ready state without remembered preparation.

units.title: Laboratory resource adapter
units.build_scope: Create a read-only process for identifying and verifying selected laboratory resources at pinned commits.
units.test_scope: Verify one source by repository, commit, path and content identity without writing to the source repository.
units.acceptance: V11 can consume a named laboratory resource with complete provenance.

units.title: First migrated engineering capability
units.build_scope: Migrate or reimplement one Product Owner-selected engineering capability with exact source provenance.
units.test_scope: Prove the selected behaviour independently inside V11.
units.acceptance: The capability becomes V11 authority only after V11 validation passes.
